title: CoDiAJe — The Annotated Diachronic Corpus of Judeo-Spanish
notes: Multi-alphabetic annotated diachronic corpus of Judeo-Spanish (16th–21st c.) built in TEITOK (TEI-XML over CQP); hosted with a live TEITOK interface at LINDAT/CLARIN. Directed by Aldina Quintana (Hebrew University of Jerusalem); described in Scriptum Digital 9 (2020). The project's description page is on Aldina Quintana's HUJI site. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Aldina Quintana, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, with Maarten Janssen (Charles University) and Josep M. Fontana (UPF); ISF grants 473/11, 486/19
